population_breakdown.extracted_skills_provenance_basis: Extraction baseline with PROVENANCE.json, excluding sandbase-mcp and aspire
population_breakdown.catalog_exclusion_rationale: Namespace/package wrappers without independent top-level SKILL.md (e.g. skillsweb/) are excluded by catalog generator

STATIC.claims: Static validity, schema compliance, docstring completeness, structural dependencies for 3,450 skills.
STATIC.provenance: Independently proven by reproducible repository inspection.

SEMANTIC.claims: Jaccard lexical similarity, intent classification, redundancy cohorts, dual evaluator agreement.
SEMANTIC.provenance: Independently proven by static similarity/evaluation methodology; does not establish runtime effectiveness.

STRUCTURAL_RUNTIME.claims: Candidate skill execution in sandboxed fixture test harness across 100 cases (30 repaired traces).
STRUCTURAL_RUNTIME.provenance: NOT_ESTABLISHED_AS_CAUSAL_RUNTIME_EVIDENCE. The benchmark exercised isolated script fixtures without live agent OODA loops or user outcome verification.

REAL_RUNTIME.claims: Live causal runtime effectiveness of installed skills in production development workflows.
REAL_RUNTIME.provenance: NOT_ESTABLISHED. No empirical production execution outcome data exists.

SECURITY.claims: Gating of P0-P18 invariants, removal of 2 CRITICAL skills, deletion of 6 confirmed Defender XSS payloads, and full delegation of recall_cli to MemoryController.
SECURITY.provenance: Independently proven against Windows Defender subsystem (Get-MpThreatDetection) and passing pytest suites.

PROVENANCE.claims: Origin URLs, extraction manifests, git commit anchors, and deduplication clusters.
PROVENANCE.provenance: Independently proven by git commit trees and upstream source URLs.

retrieval_remediation_status.historical_state_at_28c371ac: Fragmented entry points existed; recall_cli.py and dispatch_cli.py bypassed MemoryController via raw os.walk string matching.
retrieval_remediation_status.current_state_at_head: Remediated in 9bf43b05f. recall_cli.py delegates directly to MemoryController.search() under Principal.AI_AGENT, enforcing P0-P15 trust boundaries, query sanitization, context budgets, and SHA-256 audit logging. MultiAgentDispatcher resolves cleanly in orchestrator.py.

remaining_architectural_gaps.description: Cognitive workers in cognitive_core/orchestrator.py and executive.py define model_tier metadata (light/standard/heavy) but lack production streaming bindings to live LLM providers outside of local Ollama or test mocks.

Council token telemetry tracks budgets and step counts, but full multi-step causal execution graphs connecting user goal -> intent -> retrieved memory IDs -> tool calls -> final output are not durably persisted.
Outcome event schema exists (04_MEMORY/outcome_events.jsonl), but automated verification attributing success/failure specifically to retrieved memory notes vs. model capability is not implemented.
Automatic memory self-refinement (adjusting memory confidence scores or proposing superseding notes based on empirical task outcomes) is not closed.
Obsidian markdown wikilinks graph and SQLite WAL database (vault_memory.sqlite3) operate as separate indexes, requiring ongoing bidirectional synchronization.
